ticket.subject: Due date jumps to the 1st
ticket.body_text:
Hi,

When I set a recurring task's due date to the 31st, it moves to the 1st of the next month in months with 30 days. Is that expected, and how do I keep it at month-end? Our payroll reminders depend on it and the next one is due this week.

Thanks,
Henrik

label_notes: howto vs bug: this is documented behaviour with a 'last day of month' option, so howto; it blocks payroll reminders = P3; this week = medium.
